desc: Build trie with node counts and per-word endpoint mapping (list of indices per terminal node).
Classify nodes: always_on if count >= k+1, fragile if count == k, record depths.
DFS from root maintaining a max-heap of fragile node depths; handle root removal; for each child, pop, record for endpoints, recurse, push back.
Compute D_high = max depth of always_on nodes; final answer[i] = max(D_high, recorded_value) if n > k else 0.
Test on provided examples and edge cases (e.g., all identical words, n==k).
